Also by the time I finished the MRP video and posted the issue, that crash console window finally finished whatever it was doing and got back to the terminal input of the path and such:
```yaml
WARNING: 2 RIDs of type "CanvasItem" were leaked.
     at: _free_rids (servers/rendering/renderer_canvas_cull.cpp:2679)
Generated 'res://save.txt' preview in 207 usec
PS D:\user\Downloads\godotstuff>
```
So it was hanging for a good 15 minutes or so.

Is it also reproducible in version `4.3-stable`? https://godotengine.org/download/archive/

And are any virus scanners active?

-----------

On MacOs 15 (v4.4.beta4) I could not detect any crashes, from time to time I see the following output, but sometimes this output is missing.

```
_notification
_quit_steps
on_quit
save_user_settings
  ERROR: File saved
_quit_app

```

<details><summary>MRP GdScript</summary>

-------------


```gdscript
extends Control

const NUM_0 = 0
const NUM_NEG_1 = -1
const CHAR_BLANK = ""
const CHAR_UNDER = "_"
const CHAR_SLASH_FORWARD = "/"
const TEXT_NAME = "name"
const TEXT_OTHER = "other"

var save_data := RichTextLabel.new()

func _ready() -> void:
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.8).timeout
	_notification(NOTIFICATION_WM_CLOSE_REQUEST)

func _notification(what):
	match what:
		NOTIFICATION_WM_CLOSE_REQUEST:
			print("_notification")
			_quit_steps()

func save_user_settings() -> void:
	print("save_user_settings")
	var file := FileAccess.open("res://save.txt",FileAccess.WRITE_READ)
	var conf := ConfigFile.new()
	data_to_config(save_data,conf)
	file.store_string(conf.encode_to_text())
	file.close()
	printerr("File saved")

func _quit_steps() -> void:
	print("_quit_steps")
	on_quit()
	_quit_app()

func on_quit() -> void:
	print("on_quit")
	save_user_settings()

func _quit_app() -> void:
	print("_quit_app")
	get_tree().quit()

static func data_to_config(
	data:Variant,
	config:ConfigFile,
) -> void:
	var temp_cat :String= CHAR_BLANK
	var temp_num :int= NUM_NEG_1
	for item in data.get_property_list():
		temp_num = which_char_first(
			item[TEXT_NAME],
			[
				CHAR_SLASH_FORWARD,
				CHAR_UNDER,
			])
		if temp_num > NUM_0:
			temp_cat = item[TEXT_NAME].left(temp_num)
		config.set_value(
			temp_cat if temp_cat != CHAR_BLANK else TEXT_OTHER,
			item[TEXT_NAME],
			data.get(item[TEXT_NAME]),
		)

static func which_char_first(
	text:String,
	char_arr:Array[String],
) -> int:
	var ret_val :int= NUM_NEG_1
	var temp_num :int= NUM_NEG_1
	for i in char_arr:
		temp_num = text.find(i)
		if temp_num > NUM_0:
			if ret_val < NUM_0:
				ret_val = temp_num
			elif ret_val > NUM_0 and temp_num < ret_val:
				ret_val = temp_num
	return ret_val

```
</details>

I am not sure how to reproduce the crash, it first happened when I was recording the video, would need to test more to find out the cause to repeat it. The main reason for the bug report was the output of godot vs console being different though. As for anti-virus, I have Malwarebytes.

I tested it in v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8] and had the same cut-off output:
```yaml
Godot Engine v4.3.stable.official.77dcf97d8 - https://godotengine.org
OpenGL API 3.3.0 NVIDIA 572.42 - Compatibility - Using Device: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070

_notification
_quit_steps
on_quit
save_user_settings

```

I also tested some in 4.3 and a scons build of 4.4 beta 4 and have not been able to repeat the crash yet.

Updated the main post to include that the godot vs console output cut off happens in:
v4.4.beta4.official [93d270693]
v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8]
v4.0.stable.official [92bee43ad]

does not happen on 3.6:
v3.6.stable.official [de2f0f147]

<details>
  <summary>Godot 3.6 version of the code. May not be the best down conversion but seemed to work</summary>

```gdscript
extends Control

const NUM_0 = 0
const NUM_NEG_1 = -1
const CHAR_BLANK = ""
const CHAR_UNDER = "_"
const CHAR_SLASH_FORWARD = "/"
const CHAR_NEW_LINE = "\n"
const CHAR_EQUAL = "="
const CHAR_BRACKET_OPEN = "["
const CHAR_BRACKET_CLOSE = "]"
const TEXT_NAME = "name"
const TEXT_OTHER = "other"

var save_data := RichTextLabel.new()

func _ready() -> void:
	yield(get_tree().create_timer(0.8), "timeout")
	_notification(MainLoop.NOTIFICATION_WM_QUIT_REQUEST)

func _notification(what):
	match what:
		MainLoop.NOTIFICATION_WM_QUIT_REQUEST:
			print("_notification")
			_quit_steps()

func save_user_settings() -> void:
	print("save_user_settings")
	var file := File.new()
	file.open("res://save.txt",File.WRITE_READ)
	var conf := ConfigFile.new()
	data_to_config(save_data,conf)
	file.store_string(encode_to_text(conf))
	file.close()
	printerr("File saved")

func encode_to_text(
	conf:ConfigFile
) -> String:
	var temp_str := CHAR_BLANK
	for sect in conf.get_sections():
		temp_str += CHAR_BRACKET_OPEN
		temp_str += sect
		temp_str += CHAR_BRACKET_CLOSE
		temp_str += CHAR_NEW_LINE
		temp_str += CHAR_NEW_LINE
		for key in conf.get_section_keys(sect):
			temp_str += key
			temp_str += CHAR_EQUAL
			temp_str += str(conf.get_value(sect,key))
			temp_str += CHAR_NEW_LINE
		temp_str += CHAR_NEW_LINE
	return temp_str

func _quit_steps() -> void:
	print("_quit_steps")
	on_quit()
	_quit_app()

func on_quit() -> void:
	print("on_quit")
	save_user_settings()

func _quit_app() -> void:
	print("_quit_app")
	get_tree().quit()

static func data_to_config(
	data,
	config:ConfigFile
) -> void:
	var temp_cat :String= CHAR_BLANK
	var temp_num :int= NUM_NEG_1
	for item in data.get_property_list():
		temp_num = which_char_first(
			item[TEXT_NAME],
			[
				CHAR_SLASH_FORWARD,
				CHAR_UNDER,
			])
		if temp_num > NUM_0:
			temp_cat = item[TEXT_NAME].left(temp_num)
		config.set_value(
			temp_cat if temp_cat != CHAR_BLANK else TEXT_OTHER,
			item[TEXT_NAME],
			data.get(item[TEXT_NAME])
		)

static func which_char_first(
	text:String,
	char_arr:Array
) -> int:
	var ret_val :int= NUM_NEG_1
	var temp_num :int= NUM_NEG_1
	for i in char_arr:
		temp_num = text.find(i)
		if temp_num > NUM_0:
			if ret_val < NUM_0:
				ret_val = temp_num
			elif ret_val > NUM_0 and temp_num < ret_val:
				ret_val = temp_num
	return ret_val

```

</details>

> I am not sure how to reproduce the crash, it first happened when I was recording the video, would need to test more to find out the cause to repeat it.

Ok, I think there is a conflict with applications that also access your graphics card. 


I'm not sure if this issue is enough for `tag:regression`. 
From version 4.x a lot has changed and needs to be ported correctly.

---------

With a short timeout before `quit()` I could now always see the output.

```gdscript
func _quit_app() -> void:
	print("_quit_app in 1s")
	await get_tree().create_timer(1.0).timeout
	get_tree().quit()

```
Yep! Adding the await timer in the _quit_app function fixes it, thank you. Not sure why that did it, but cheers!
